description: This Java source file defines the MigrationHelper class, which provides utility methods for migrating data within the OpenMRS healthcare platform. The class includes methods for parsing dates and XML, importing users, locations, relationships, and program statuses from XML or string data, primarily used during data migration or system upgrades. Many methods are marked as deprecated, indicating they are intended for removal or replacement in future versions.

classes.name: MigrationHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to assist in data migration tasks within the OpenMRS platform. Includes functionalities for parsing dates and XML data, importing users, locations, relationships, and program statuses, primarily for migration or upgrade purposes.

methods.name: parseDate
methods.description: Parses a date string into a Date object, supporting yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss and yyyy-MM-dd formats.

methods.name: parseXml
methods.description: Parses an XML string into a Document object, disabling external entity resolution for security.

methods.name: importUsers
methods.description: Imports user data from an XML Document, adding new users to the system.

methods.name: importLocations
methods.description: Imports location data from an XML Document, adding new locations.

methods.name: importRelationships
methods.description: Establishes relationships between patients and users based on a collection of relationship strings.

methods.name: importProgramsAndStatuses
methods.description: Imports patient program enrollments and statuses from a list of strings.
